intro: Which notifications Windows shows, where it shows them, and the tips and suggestions it mixes in with them.

Additional Settings.blurb: The welcome experience after updates, setup suggestions, and tips while you use Windows.
html:
Also set from Privacy & Security

Three of these are linked to Ads, Suggestions and Promotional Content. Choosing Allow or Deny there turns them on or off along with the other promotional settings.

groups.System Notifications: Notifications when apps ask for access, when an app is added to startup, and when the clock changes for daylight saving time.
groups.Privacy Notifications: A notification when an app asks for your location.
groups.Security Notifications: Notifications from Windows Security and from Security and Maintenance.
groups.General: Notifications as a whole. The sound and lock screen settings can only be changed while Show Notifications is on.
